raw_text: Massive thread on r/Sudan with firsthand accounts from residents. People trapped in homes, hearing constant gunfire and explosions. Internet going in and out. Reports of RSF fighters looting shops in Khartoum Market area. Several users posting about family members unable to reach hospitals. The humanitarian situation is deteriorating rapidly.
